snippet.title: Maniax for Amiga by Kingsoft
snippet.description: Maniax for Amiga by Kingsoft. This one has Super Qix written all over it. Unlike Torch 2081 you uncover actual pictures rather than just filling in patterns. At least this gives the player some incentive to play on to see what the next image will be. A few power ups in the game.
